summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandfather; born at San Mango d'Aquino to a bracciale (day-labourer) family.
bio: Tree: Domenico Fiorillo (1840-1927) + Saveria Colosimo (1848-1926). Round 3: born 27 Dec 1840, San Mango d'Aquino, Nati 1840 act 79; father Carmine Fiorillo, 32, bracciale; mother Giuseppina Ferlaino; one witness was Gaetano Colosimo, 40; the Sindaco was Dr. Bruno Sacco. All 5 of Calabria's documented Fiorillo US arrivals came from San Mango (paese.app); the 1990s San Mango phone directory lists Fiorillo x7. But the parish stati delle anime 1674-1804 have NO Fiorillo, so the family arrived in San Mango in the 1800s.
sources: Antenati, San Mango d'Aquino, Nati 1840, act 79: https://antenati.cultura.gov.it/ark:/12657/an_ua37933123/LNZdd7O ; https://antenati.cultura.gov.it/ark:/12657/an_ua37933123/LevKKpD
